scope: Official upstream SparkFun, ProtoCentral and Seeed source candidates. This is a technical source/license evidence inventory, not a redistribution clearance or legal conclusion.
methodology: Candidate repositories were identified from graph and source-board filenames and official upstream repository trees.

Git blob hashes compare private local raw boards with upstream files. Structural comparisons cover component name/value/package/x/y/rotation and exact net contact references; editor text placement is ignored.
Explicit hardware or whole repository licensing notices are recorded, with version taken only from an explicit license URL or named version. Conflicting applicable notices stay unresolved.
Every graph remains pending graph revision, attribution, third-party rights and redistribution review; no graph is marked release-cleared.
